segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making time. I wanted to walk through the quote for 42 seats and make sure the March 18 go-live still works on your side.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, March 18 is still the target. We have 38 users confirmed today, but finance asked us to budget for 42 because we expect four more in Q2.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That makes sense. The pricing sheet has the 42-seat annual plan at $31,500, and implementation is a one-time $4,800. If you start with 38 active users, we can still contract for 42 and just provision the remaining seats when you're ready.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the invoice, would that be one invoice for the annual subscription plus implementation, or split out?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: We can do either. Standard is one invoice for $36,300 due net 30, but if your AP team wants services separated, I can have billing issue two invoices.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: One invoice is fine. Our only ask is that the PO number be included on the invoice. It'll be PO-41782.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, PO-41782. On contract terms, we're using the 12-month agreement starting March 18, with renewal notice at 60 days. Any redlines from legal, or are you comfortable with the current draft?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Legal reviewed it yesterday. They were fine with it as long as the data processing addendum stays attached. No other changes.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. For onboarding, we'd schedule the kickoff the week of February 26, then admin training on March 6 and end-user training on March 13. Does that line up with your team's availability?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, March 6 and March 13 both work. Please send the calendar holds to me and Marcus, he's our operations lead.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll send the final order form today with the 42 seats, $36,300 total, net 30, PO number included, and the March 18 start date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send it over and I should be able to get signature by Friday.
